name: Halo
tagline: An iPhone AR app with a calm voice agent that coaches bystanders through emergencies like CPR.
problem: Bystanders freeze in medical emergencies for lack of knowledge and confidence.
solution: ARKit body tracking and Vision/CoreML map a person's joints in real time while an empathetic AI voice guides the bystander, on devices people already carry.
demo_moment: Team-described: point the phone at a person and get guided compressions.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Infosys Human Augmentation Track Prize” among 160 submissions.
Runs on ordinary phones, no headset needed.

lessons: Augment ordinary people with hardware they already carry.
